purpose: Teach: 上回る/補給/含み/順次/終える/レギュラー/当店/常時

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当店の主力商品、レギュラーで売上が予測を上回る勢いだ。
lines.en: Our flagship product—regular sales are beating forecast.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Steady pace, assured. The tone of someone reporting good news without fanfare. Slight pause at the dash for emphasis on the metric.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。順次補給を入れ、欠品を起こさず終える予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We'll replenish in sequence and finish without any stock-outs.
lines.style: Attentive and solution-focused. Measured pace, each phrase distinct and clear. Respectful acknowledgment—not eager, but present and reliable.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 常時の在庫量、見直しも含み、来月議論しよう。
lines.en: Let's revisit standing inventory levels—including a full review—and discuss it next month.
lines.style: Deliberate and forward-thinking. Slight weight on 'revisit.' Paced to give each clause room to land. The voice of someone delegating thoughtfully, not hastily.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Clipped, direct. No softening. Professional expectation delivered as simple fact. Quick, efficient—the end of the thought, not the start of negotiation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Brief and genuine. Quiet close—not dismissive, but the natural punctuation to a professional exchange. Warmth underneath the brevity.
